name: Sex Pistols

whyMatters.en: London punk band formed in 1975. EMI and Virgin singles plus Never Mind the Bollocks (1977) set a short UK punk reference: high-gain power chords, straight drums, and Lydon’s spoken-sung vocal.
whyMatters.zh: 伦敦朋克乐队，1975 年成立。EMI、Virgin 单曲与《Never Mind the Bollocks》（1977）构成英国朋克的短参考：高增益强力和弦、直线鼓点，以及 Lydon 的说唱式人声。

note.en: EMI single. Jones on high-gain guitar; Lydon vocal; Matlock-era writing.
note.zh: EMI 单曲。Jones 高增益吉他；Lydon 人声；Matlock 时期写作。

note.en: Released during the Silver Jubilee year; BBC ban and chart disputes followed.
note.zh: 银禧年发行；随后有 BBC 禁播与榜单争议。

note.en: Open power-chord riff; Cook’s straight eighths on drums.
note.zh: 开放强力和弦 riff；Cook 直线八分鼓点。

interviewQuotes.text: We're not into music. We're into chaos.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Johnny Rotten

interviewQuotes.text: Ever get the feeling you've been cheated?
interviewQuotes.speaker: Johnny Rotten

lyricQuotes: I am an antichrist / I am an anarchist
God save the queen, the fascist regime

shortBio.en: London punk, 1975–78. Rotten, Jones, Cook; Matlock then Vicious on bass. Anarchy in the U.K. and Never Mind the Bollocks are the core references.
shortBio.zh: 伦敦朋克，1975–78。Rotten、Jones、Cook；贝斯先后为 Matlock 与 Vicious。《Anarchy in the U.K.》与《Never Mind the Bollocks》是主要参照。

body.en:
Sex Pistols formed in London in 1975. The sound centers on Steve Jones’s high-gain power chords, Paul Cook’s straight drums, and Johnny Rotten’s (John Lydon) spoken-sung vocal. Glen Matlock co-wrote early singles; Sid Vicious replaced him on bass in 1977.

EMI released Anarchy in the U.K. (1976). Virgin issued God Save the Queen, Pretty Vacant, and Holidays in the Sun (1977). Never Mind the Bollocks, Here’s the Sex Pistols (1977) is the only studio album. The band ended after the January 1978 Winterland show in San Francisco. Lydon later formed Public Image Ltd.
body.zh:
Sex Pistols 于 1975 年在伦敦成立。声音核心是 Steve Jones 的高增益强力和弦、Paul Cook 的直线鼓点，以及 Johnny Rotten（John Lydon）的说唱式人声。Glen Matlock 参与早期单曲写作；1977 年 Sid Vicious 接替贝斯。

EMI 发行《Anarchy in the U.K.》（1976）。Virgin 发行《God Save the Queen》《Pretty Vacant》《Holidays in the Sun》（1977）。《Never Mind the Bollocks, Here’s the Sex Pistols》（1977）是唯一录音室专辑。乐队在 1978 年 1 月旧金山 Winterland 演出后结束。Lydon 随后组建 Public Image Ltd。

body.en:
The main records fall in 1976–77: EMI and Virgin singles, then Never Mind the Bollocks. Faster tempos, few solos, and Lydon’s sneering vocal mark the sound.

Press coverage was heavy; the songs themselves stay short and playable.
body.zh:
主要唱片集中在 1976–77：EMI 与 Virgin 单曲，以及《Never Mind the Bollocks》。更快的速度、很少独奏，以及 Lydon 带嘲讽的人声是声音标记。

媒体报道很多；歌曲本身仍短、可弹。

body.en:
Glen Matlock co-wrote early singles including Anarchy in the U.K. Sid Vicious joined on bass in 1977. Steve Jones and Paul Cook stayed on guitar and drums.

On several studio tracks Jones also covered bass parts.
body.zh:
Glen Matlock 参与早期单曲写作，包括《Anarchy in the U.K.》。Sid Vicious 于 1977 年加入贝斯。Steve Jones 与 Paul Cook 留在吉他与鼓。

若干录音轨上贝斯也由 Jones 顶替。

body.en:
EMI released the single in 1976; the label relationship ended soon after. Jones’s guitar is high-gain and dense; Lydon’s vocal is spoken-sung.

Short-song timing recalls Ramones; the lyric address is British.
body.zh:
EMI 于 1976 年发行该单曲，随后与厂牌关系破裂。Jones 吉他高增益、密集；Lydon 人声为说唱式。

短歌时值接近 Ramones；歌词内容是英国本土的。

body.en:
Steve Jones plays stacked power chords. Paul Cook keeps drums simple and loud. Lydon is the public face; the bass chair changes once.

After the band ended, Lydon formed Public Image Ltd.
body.zh:
Steve Jones 演奏叠置强力和弦。Paul Cook 鼓点简单且响。Lydon 是公开形象；贝斯席更换一次。

乐队结束后，Lydon 组建 Public Image Ltd。

title.zh: 媒体句与 Winterland 收场

body.en:
Early press used the line “We're not into music. We're into chaos.” At the 1978 Winterland show Lydon asked, “Ever get the feeling you've been cheated?”

The US tour ended there; the band did not continue as a studio unit.
body.zh:
早期媒体常用句：「We're not into music. We're into chaos.」1978 年 Winterland 演出上，Lydon 问：「Ever get the feeling you've been cheated?」

美国巡演至此结束；乐队未再以录音室编制继续。

title.zh: 与 The Clash 并列的引用

body.en:
The Clash built a longer album catalog with reggae and political writing. Sex Pistols left a shorter set of singles and one studio album. Later UK punk and hardcore often cite the tempo and attitude.

Catalog is short; citation lists stay long.
body.zh:
The Clash 留下更长的专辑目录，并写入雷鬼与政治题材。Sex Pistols 留下较短的单曲系列与一张录音室专辑。后来的英国朋克与 hardcore 常引用其速度与态度。

目录短；引用列表长。

note.en: Early singles writing; bass on Anarchy in the U.K.
note.zh: 早期单曲写作；《Anarchy in the U.K.》时期贝斯。

note.en: Bass seat 1977–78; Jones often plays bass on record.
note.zh: 1977–78 贝斯席；唱片上贝斯常由 Jones 演奏。

note.en: EMI single; Jones guitar and Lydon vocal as early UK punk markers.
note.zh: EMI 单曲；Jones 吉他与 Lydon 人声是早期英国朋克标记。

note.en: High-gain power chords and tabloid-scale press in under two years.
note.zh: 不到两年内完成高增益强力和弦与大规模媒体报道。
